faqQ1: What happens if generation fails due to a technical error?
faqA1: If our system or the AI API encounters a server error or timeout, your credit is NOT deducted (or is automatically restored). You can retry at no extra cost.
faqQ2: Can I get a cash refund for unused credits?
faqA2: No. As digital credit packages are instantly credited to your wallet upon purchase, all sales are final and non-refundable.

privacyBlocks: # Privacy Policy – AnimaDisegni
Last updated: November 3, 2026
## 1. Data controller
The data controller is:

Fulvio Cherubini
Anguillara Sabazia (RM), Italy
Email: @assistenza.animadisegni@gmail.com
For any request regarding personal data, you can contact the controller at the email address above.
## 2. Data collected
While using AnimaDisegni, the following data may be processed:
- Name, email address and Google identifier, if the user chooses to sign in with Google.
- Account and wallet identifiers, credits and transactions.
- Purchase information: package, amount, currency and transaction identifiers.
- Drawings, photographs and images uploaded by the user.
- Generated videos, texts and card customizations.
- Technical data needed for the operation and security of the service.
AnimaDisegni does not directly collect or store payment card numbers.
## 3. Purposes of processing
Data is used to:
- allow account access and management;
- process images and generate the requested videos;
- manage credits, purchases and payments;
- provide user support;
- ensure the security and proper functioning of the service;
- comply with legal obligations.
Processing is based on the performance of the service requested by the user, on legal obligations and, where applicable, on the controller's legitimate interest.
## 4. Images and videos
Uploaded images are sent to the technology services needed to process them, in particular Fal.ai and the Kling video generation models.
Content is used to provide the feature requested by the user. AnimaDisegni does not automatically publish images or videos in a public gallery.
Users decide on their own whether and where to share the videos they download.
Anyone uploading images declares that they hold the rights and permissions needed to use them, including any permission from parents or guardians when minors are depicted.
## 5. External services
The following services are used to run AnimaDisegni:
- Google: authentication and Google Fonts.
- Vercel: application hosting.
- Neon: data storage in the database.
- Fal.ai: image processing and handling of the files needed to generate videos.
- Stripe: payment processing.
Providers process data according to their respective privacy notices and applicable terms.
## 6. Cookies and data stored in the browser
AnimaDisegni uses a technical cookie named am_session, needed to keep the sign-in session, with an expected duration of 30 days.
The site also uses:
- localStorage to keep the wallet identifier and the chosen language;
- sessionStorage to temporarily keep images, customizations and information needed to generate videos.
No advertising profiling systems or statistical analysis tools such as Google Analytics are installed in the code.
Google and Stripe services may use their own technical tools according to their respective privacy notices.
## 7. Data retention
Data is kept for the time necessary for the purposes of processing and in compliance with legal obligations.
Account data is kept to allow use of the service. Data relating to purchases and transactions may be kept for administrative and tax obligations.
Images and videos may be temporarily kept by technology providers to allow the processing and delivery of content. Timing may vary depending on the services used and their technical arrangements.
## 8. Data transfers

Some technology providers may also process data outside the European Economic Area. Such transfers take place in compliance with the conditions and safeguards required by European data protection law.
## 9. User rights
Users may exercise, in the cases provided by law, the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, objection and data portability, where applicable.
Requests can be sent to:
@assistenza.animadisegni@gmail.com
Erasure may be limited where retention obligations are required by law.
Users also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante per la protezione dei dati personali):
@https://www.garanteprivacy.it/
## 10. Security

AnimaDisegni adopts technical and organizational measures to protect personal data, including HTTPS connections, session protection and controls on communications between the application and external services.
## 11. Updates
This notice may be updated if the service or the way data is processed changes. The updated version will be published on this page.
